decisions.reason: Naval vessel lighting has long defence procurement cycles and rising naval demand, so its value is still uncertain and keeping it in the specialist portfolio costs little.
The spring-balanced desk lamp still fits the ergonomic workplace portfolio at low holding cost, and two years of evidence is not yet enough to show its value will not be realized.
As a second-generation core interior luminaire with low uncertainty, it is a committed product rather than a speculative option, and there is no reason to abandon it.
The microprismatic pendant is a flagship of the firm's direction toward efficient, glare-free lighting, so it merits further commitment.

Withdrawing the HMI searchlight suggests the firm is consolidating its marine searchlight range, but this line likely serves as the remaining searchlight offer, so the option stays open for now at somewhat higher risk.
